feature_contract.goal: Ensure complete stage +TIME sprite and numeric glyphs retain their original exact D3DX owner from six source CALLs to delayed GPU submission and R26+HUD eye projection, including the first queued sprite after a direct buffer.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only six original +TIME 0x989xx source calls, immediate/queued D3DX owner and true GPU submission; no global Flush, generic HUD ownership, GOAL/rank rewrites, timer changes, SkyGlow or other backends.
trace_stages: Six canonical +TIME sprani and numeric CALL parents bracket scoped direct glyph raster and tag the exact appended SpriteNodes.

D3DX Begin/Draw provenance and pre-queue transition isolate a homogeneous old direct batch before selecting the first +TIME queue owner; matching queued or direct +TIME submits before semantic lifetime ends.
R26+HUD packaged stereo renderer and x64 host process the exact ScreenHud draw into both eye projections; optical correctness requires later Quest3/VDXR testing.
subcomponents: Restore the first-node direct-to-stage D3DX GPU batch boundary without stealing the previous owner's scope.
Cover all six original +TIME source and numeric paths plus mixed, stale, unrelated first queue and GOAL/rank negative cases.
Keep R26+HUD packaged eye ownership, normal clock, input, SkyGlow and original desktop fallback with exact-SHA integration gates.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Six original E8 source and GPU batch
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Three +TIME sprani plus three numeric CALLs keep the original semantic scope until actual direct and queued D3DX submission including first queue transition.
Previous homogeneous direct batch flushes before a new stage queue tag; Stage ScreenHud drives both eye paths while original ownership is preserved.
Mixed, mismatched or untracked buffers never inherit +TIME; GOAL, rank and original timer/FFB behavior remain protected.

acceptance_items.behavior_area: Final GitHub exact-SHA Windows build and package
acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Active x86 game, x64 OpenXR host, full-chain, packaged R26 owner and Domain/impact gates pass at final validation-bearing SHA.

diagnosis.original_evidence: StageExtensionEnter/Leave and six original CALLs, queued replay and D3DX Draw/Flush hooks already exist; queue's first node is still rejected by !QueueRenderActive when an otherwise homogeneous previous direct buffer is pending.
source_trace: 0x9898E/0x98A36/0x98AC6 decorated source and 0x989AD/0x98A10/0x98A89 numeric parent tags.
BeforeQueueNode runs before SelectSpriteQueueNode and must flush a proven old direct D3DX buffer before replacing the source.
DrawDest and packaged R26+HUD fixedfn/VS renderer submit stage HUD through both eyes and OpenXR host.
diagnosis.root_cause: A homogeneous directly sourced buffer pending at first StageExtensionTime queue node previously disabled StageBoundaryReady solely because QueueRenderActive was false, leaving later D3DX End outside producer scope.
alternatives_rejected: No missing E8 producer or extra generic HUD hook: six exact original calls and queue replay already exist; an unproven mixed or different-owner buffer still must not be promoted.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Shared C++ predicate allows first-node isolation only when entering exact StageExtensionTime and pending old source/scope match live outgoing original owner, with existing queue rules otherwise unchanged.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: C++ static asserts and Python destructive checks for first queued +TIME, stale/mixed/mismatched, unrelated first queue, original GOAL/rank hooks.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: The previous direct batch stays with the old eye scope until flushed; only the subsequent producer-authenticated +TIME queue draws receive ScreenHud stereo presentation.

runtime_evidence: No Quest3/VDXR gameplay test; binocular image and FPS not proven.
